description: Budget estimate (integer cents) for a published itinerary: activities, lodging, transport and flights for a tier, a month or the year average, and a group.

city.description: City slug from list_cities, e.g. lisbon.

friday.description: The Friday of the weekend as a YYYY-MM-DD date (it must be a Friday); the weekend runs Friday to Monday. Enables a real fare.

lang.description: BCP 47 language of the published text, e.g. es (default English).

month.description: Month of travel, or the twelve-month mean (default).

origin.description: Origin slug from list_origins, e.g. barcelona; adds flights.

persona.description: Persona slug from list_personas, e.g. foodie.

tier.description: Budget tier, cheapest to most lavish (default modest). Scales every price line.

travellers.description: Group size, 1-20 (default 2). Prices are for the whole group.

name: estimate_itinerary
title: Price a weekend
